vla.reason: This published checkpoint expects 29 body joints, 14 articulated hand joints and WBC base-height/navigation control. The current locomotion model has 29 body actuators and fixed hands. No VLA actions are sent to it.
vla.input_note: Camera image and 29 body states are from a real native simulation snapshot; absent hand channels are zero-filled ONLY to smoke-test the neural runtime. This is not a compatible robot rollout or a task-success evaluation.

disturbance_protocol.resume_criterion: height > 0.65 m and tilt < 30 deg continuously for 2 s
disturbance_protocol.axis_note: The force is along the fixed world Y axis; depending on robot heading, it is not always lateral in body coordinates.

definitions.completed: The saved trial status is completed and the full route finished.
definitions.timeout: The saved trial reached its simulation-time horizon before full route completion; timeout is not a fall.
definitions.fall: A fall is counted when the saved status is fallen/fall/fell, first_fall_s is present, or fall_episodes is positive. A trial can also have another ending status.
definitions.technical_error: A technical error is an explicit technical_error/error/exception trial status, not a locomotion failure.
